verdicts.reason: A pushes the quote mark and the quote text to about 15px from the left edge. The attribution sits right under the quote with almost no gap, and the SOLSTICE logo is squeezed beneath it, off the text's left edge and tiny. The jar and circle dominate, and the circle is clipped at the bottom. B gives the text block comfortable margins and better line breaks, and the quote and attribution are spaced well. However, its logo sits left of the text column and is tiny, and the jar is shrunk inside a large circle that is also cropped at the bottom, which leaves the right side weak.
